basic_profile.bio: A 32-year-old mom of one energetic toddler and expecting another child soon. I'm based in the Midwest and work part-time as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me to balance work and family life. I love evening walks with my daughter and husband, and I'm passionate about advocating for children to be seen as individuals rather than stereotypes. I dislike gender essentialism and often find myself online during late afternoons when my daughter naps or late evenings after she goes to bed. I'm in a happy marriage and enjoy connecting with other parents online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts and have worked various creative jobs before switching to freelance graphic design after my daughter was born. My knowledge about parenting and child development is mostly self-taught through experience and actively engaging in parenting forums and reading articles.
